project_type: Python FastAPI async web application - Enterprise Document Management System
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (asyncio_mode=auto), httpx AsyncClient, SQLAlchemy async sessions with in-memory SQLite test DB
build_command: uv run ruff check app/ tests/
verification_instructions: 1) Run `uv run ruff check app/ tests/` for lint. 2) Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and confirm all tests pass (baseline: 268 passing). 3) Verify new modules import correctly.
setup_instructions: Already set up - .venv exists, uv sync done, 268 tests pass
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode. No Docker daemon needed. Python 3.11.14 via pyenv. uv package manager.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns: SQLAlchemy 2.0 mapped_column style, Pydantic v2 schemas with model_config from_attributes, FastAPI routers with dependency injection, pytest-asyncio tests using conftest fixtures (client, db_session)
key_patterns: Models inherit from Base (defined in app/models/group.py). Schemas use Pydantic BaseModel with model_config = {from_attributes: True}. API routes use APIRouter with tags. Tests use pytest_asyncio fixtures with httpx AsyncClient. Auth uses JWT Bearer tokens via get_current_user dependency. Role checks via role_required/require_role. Background tasks via FastAPI BackgroundTasks. Storage uses StorageService with group-based directory layout.
directory_structure: app/ - main application (api/, core/, models/, schemas/, services/, templates/). tests/ - pytest test files with conftest.py. data/ - runtime storage. wiki/ - LLM wiki files. chroma_db/ - vector database.
